singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular state COMMAND

Create a registry on the proved design

The state commands make the registry of an application: its state, a single
output that holds the registry's token and the root of its keys. The registry
is named by its seed, an output of your wallet, and by the application whose
policy the state validator is made for. The commands take the compiled
validators of the release (--blueprint) and a single signer.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  create   Create the registry of an application
